messages:
maria: Heads-up, uploaded fresh benchmark artifacts: summary, raw CSVs, and two visual drafts. Objective: finalize narrative and asset plan for mid-April launch. Need decisions on hero metric, legal-safe claims, and lead capture flow.

tom: Nice. Quick take: hero should be p50 for PLG (snappy perceived perf) and p95 for enterprise messaging. Use 'up to' phrasing on cost deltas.

rachel: For visuals I like a three-panel approach on the blog: hero delta badge, latency CDF, and a cost-vs-latency scatter with highlighted configs. For PLG landing keep it minimal: hero stat + try button.

jon: Can we also provide an interactive table for engineers to toggle sequence length? Small JS widget would help show where batching/kv cache matters.

priya: Lead flow: Landing form fields = email, company, company_size (range), expected_monthly_tokens (range), primary_use_case. If company_size>200 OR expected_monthly_tokens>20M -> tag as "Enterprise-fit" and route to AE. Else auto-enroll in product drip.

maria: Good. Add a checkbox "Interested in private deployment" and route that to Enterprise AE regardless of size. Also capture 'need_SLA' boolean.

tom: On wording: avoid absolute multipliers without the baseline model and config in the copy. Example copy: "Up to 1.7x lower per-token cost on short chat sequences compared to our baseline X.x model on Y GPU; see paper for test harness."

rachel: Visual accessibility note: use ColorBrewer 2-class palette and ensure patterns or labels for non-color cues.

jon: Data transparency: include a small methodology card in the blog that lists models, quantization, batch sizes, sequence distributions, and infra specs. Link raw CSVs and seed scripts.

priya: Webinar idea: 45-minute tech demo + 15-min Q&A: "Practical choices to trade latency for cost when serving LLMs". Offer the benchmark whitepaper as gated asset. Route registrants per same scoring rules.

maria: Great. Marketing asks: (1) two headline variants (PLG vs Enterprise), (2) hero stat values for 64/128/512 seq lengths, (3) blog charts and annotations, (4) gated whitepaper. Can owners please volunteer?

tom: I'll own hero numbers and the delta badges. Will push a CSV with p50/p95/cost-per-1k for the three seq lengths by EOD tomorrow.

rachel: I'll produce the three-panel static comps + accessibility pass. Expect drafts in 48h.

jon: I'll scope the interactive table/widget and note required props for frontend. Need a small JSON API endpoint with the CSVs.

priya: I'll wire the HubSpot form and an automation: create Company + Contact, score, and assign to queue. I'll add UTM tracking and events: bench_download, webinar_register, landing_try_click.

integrator-bot: [system] artifact uploaded: /shared/marketing/bench/exports/bench-raw-2026-03-21.csv by maria at 2026-03-21T15:02:10Z

maria: Thanks. Quick decision points: 1) Hero metric for PLG = p50(128). 2) Blog lead gating = whitepaper behind form + optional sample dataset download after email confirm. 3) Copy tone: engineer-first, but include an enterprise callout for Dedicated/Private. Any objections?

tom: No objections. Agree with the tone.

rachel: LGTM. One copy nit: use 'median' instead of 'p50' on consumer-facing pages.

jon: FYI we'll need CORS on the CSV endpoint for the widget.

priya: Noted. I'll add webhook to AE Slack channel for Enterprise-fit leads.

maria: Perfect. Timeline: lock visuals & copy by next Wednesday, publish blog + landing on Thursday, webinar 2 weeks after publish. I'll consolidate all comments into the draft doc. Thanks team.

integrator-bot: [system] campaign ticket created: MKTBENCH-142 in Jira by maria at 2026-03-21T15:12:45Z"
